# Integrated Medical and Chiropractic Centers

> > Integrated Medical and Chiropractic Centers provides comprehensive chiropractic care, physical therapy, and personal injury treatment across multiple Inland Empire locations since 1952.

Founded by Dr. Pirritano in 1952, IMCC serves communities throughout Southern California's Inland Empire including Corona, Chino, Hemet, Lake Elsinore, Riverside, Temecula, and Wildomar. The practice offers integrated medical services combining chiropractic adjustments, physical therapy, massage therapy, and specialized personal injury care.

## Key Topics

- Chiropractic Care
- Personal Injury Treatment
- Physical Therapy

- California Victim Compensation Board
